title: Core Utilities & Extensions
summary: This module provides a diverse set of utility functions and extensions for the CrewAI framework, encompassing hook management, project structure annotations, memory analysis, logging, streaming, and telemetry.

nodes.label: Format Console Output
nodes.title: Printer
nodes.description: Handles colored console output formatting for better readability and user experience.

nodes.label: Define Async Executor Context
nodes.title: AsyncExecutorContext
nodes.description: Provides an extended context for executors that support asynchronous invocation of agent loops.

nodes.label: Clear All Global Hooks
nodes.title: clear_all_global_hooks
nodes.description: Resets all registered global LLM and tool call hooks, useful for testing or cleaning up between execution contexts.

nodes.label: Create Hook Decorators
nodes.title: decorator_factory
nodes.description: A factory function that generates decorators for various hooks, allowing filtering by specific agents or tools.

nodes.label: Register Before LLM Hook
nodes.title: before_llm_call
nodes.description: Decorator to register functions that execute before an LLM call, enabling pre-processing or logging.

nodes.label: Register After LLM Hook
nodes.title: after_llm_call
nodes.description: Decorator to register functions that execute after an LLM call, allowing post-processing or response modification.

nodes.label: Register Before Tool Hook
nodes.title: before_tool_call
nodes.description: Decorator to register functions that execute before a tool call, enabling pre-validation, human approval, or logging.

nodes.label: Register After Tool Hook
nodes.title: after_tool_call
nodes.description: Decorator to register functions that execute after a tool call, allowing post-processing of tool results.

nodes.label: Wrap Before LLM Hook Method
nodes.title: BeforeLLMCallHookMethod
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'before_llm_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: Wrap After LLM Hook Method
nodes.title: AfterLLMCallHookMethod
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'after_llm_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: Wrap Before Tool Hook Method
nodes.title: BeforeToolCallHookMethod
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'before_tool_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: Wrap After Tool Hook Method
nodes.title: AfterToolCallHookMethod
nodes.description: Wraps methods marked as 'after_tool_call' hooks within CrewBase classes, enabling crew-scoped hook registration.

nodes.label: Analyze Memory for Save
nodes.title: analyze_for_save
nodes.description: Infers optimal scope, categories, importance, and metadata for a memory record using an LLM before persistence.

nodes.label: Analyze Memory for Consolidation
nodes.title: analyze_for_consolidation
nodes.description: Determines the best action (insert, update, or delete) for a new memory record against existing similar records using an LLM.

nodes.label: Annotate as Crew Task
nodes.title: task
nodes.description: Marks a method as a CrewAI task, enabling its integration into the crew's workflow and memoization.

nodes.label: Annotate Crew Setup Wrapper
nodes.title: wrapper
nodes.description: A wrapper that orchestrates the setup of a Crew instance, including tasks and agents, before executing the decorated method.

nodes.label: Annotate as Crew Agent
nodes.title: agent
nodes.description: Marks a method as a CrewAI agent, enabling its integration into the crew's workflow and memoization.

nodes.label: Annotate as LLM Provider
nodes.title: llm
nodes.description: Marks a method as an LLM provider, allowing it to be used for language model interactions within a crew.

nodes.label: Annotate as Crew Tool
nodes.title: tool
nodes.description: Marks a method as a CrewAI tool, making it available for agents to use within their execution.

nodes.label: Annotate as Cache Handler
nodes.title: cache_handler
nodes.description: Marks a method as a cache handler, enabling custom caching logic for crew components.

nodes.label: Annotate for Pre-Kickoff
nodes.title: before_kickoff
nodes.description: Marks a method to be executed automatically before the crew's main kickoff process begins.

nodes.label: Annotate for Post-Kickoff
nodes.title: after_kickoff
nodes.description: Marks a method to be executed automatically after the crew's main kickoff process has completed.

nodes.label: Annotate Class for JSON Output
nodes.title: output_json
nodes.description: Marks a class to indicate that its output should be formatted as JSON.

nodes.label: Annotate Class for Pydantic Output
nodes.title: output_pydantic
nodes.description: Marks a class to indicate that its output should conform to a Pydantic schema.

nodes.label: CrewBase Metaclass
nodes.title: _CrewBaseType
nodes.description: A metaclass for CrewBase that enables it to function as a decorator, transforming classes into CrewAI definitions.

nodes.label: Cache Method Results
nodes.title: wrapper
nodes.description: An asynchronous wrapper function that implements caching for method results based on their arguments.

nodes.label: Base Decorated Method Wrapper
nodes.title: DecoratedMethod
nodes.description: A generic wrapper for methods that preserves their callable signature and adds metadata for various decorators.

nodes.label: Load Skill Resources
nodes.title: load_resources
nodes.description: Promotes a skill to the 'RESOURCES' disclosure level, making its associated resources accessible for use.

nodes.label: Manage Anonymous Telemetry
nodes.title: Telemetry
nodes.description: Initializes and manages anonymous usage data collection, tracing, and event logging for the CrewAI package.

nodes.label: Convert String to Callable
nodes.title: string_to_callable
nodes.description: Resolves a dotted-path string (e.g., 'module.function') into its corresponding Python callable object.

nodes.label: Base Streaming Output Handler
nodes.title: StreamingOutputBase
nodes.description: Provides a base class for handling and iterating over streaming outputs, offering access to chunks and final results.

nodes.label: Summarize LLM Conversation Chunk
nodes.title: _summarize_one
nodes.description: Asynchronously summarizes a single chunk of LLM messages, typically used for memory analysis or context compression.

nodes.label: Display Agent Execution Logs
nodes.title: show_agent_logs
nodes.description: Formats and prints detailed agent activity logs to the console, including thoughts, tool usage, and final answers.

nodes.label: Execute Crew Tool with Messages
nodes.title: run_crew_tool_with_messages
nodes.description: A utility function to execute a specified crew tool, passing along relevant messages and arguments for its operation.

nodes.label: Retrieve Crew Execution Files
nodes.title: get_files
nodes.description: Fetches files associated with a specific crew execution ID from the internal file storage system.

nodes.label: Retrieve Task Execution Files
nodes.title: get_task_files
nodes.description: Fetches files associated with a specific task ID from the internal file storage system.

nodes.label: Serialize Guardrails for JSON
nodes.title: serialize_guardrails_for_json
nodes.description: Converts guardrail configurations (single or sequence) into a JSON-serializable format for checkpointing and persistence.

nodes.label: Sanitize Bedrock Tool Params
nodes.title: sanitize_tool_params_for_bedrock_strict
nodes.description: Adjusts JSON schema parameters to ensure compatibility and strict adherence with Bedrock Converse tool use requirements.

nodes.label: Serialize Object to JSON String
nodes.title: to_string
nodes.description: Converts a Python object into a JSON-formatted string, handling various data types for serialization.

nodes.label: Handle Streaming Events
nodes.title: stream_handler
nodes.description: A handler that processes incoming LLM streaming chunk events and dispatches them to appropriate asynchronous or synchronous queues.

nodes.label: Convert Text to URL-Safe Slug
nodes.title: slugify
nodes.description: Transforms a given text string into a URL-safe, lowercase slug by normalizing Unicode characters and replacing special characters.

nodes.label: Manage Task Output Storage
nodes.title: TaskOutputStorageHandler
nodes.description: Handles the persistence, retrieval, and updating of task execution outputs using an underlying SQLite storage implementation.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration Module
nodes.description: Provides interfaces and implementations for various Large Language Models (LLMs) used by agents and other components.

nodes.label: Agent & Crew Orchestration
nodes.title: Agent & Crew Orchestration Module
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle, execution, and interaction of agents and crews within the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: File Processing & Caching
nodes.title: File Processing & Caching Module
nodes.description: Handles file storage, retrieval, and caching mechanisms for various CrewAI operations.

nodes.label: Event & State Management
nodes.title: Event & State Management Module
nodes.description: Manages system events, state changes, and event bus operations across the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: Hook Management
groups.title: Manage LLM & Tool Hooks
groups.description: Provides decorators and utilities for defining, registering, and clearing global and crew-scoped hooks that execute before or after LLM and tool calls.

groups.label: Crew Project Structure
groups.title: Define Crew Components & Flow
groups.description: Offers decorators and metaclasses to define and structure CrewAI projects, marking methods as tasks, agents, LLMs, tools, and specifying output formats or kickoff callbacks.

groups.label: Memory Analysis
groups.title: Analyze & Consolidate Memory
groups.description: Contains functions that use LLMs to analyze memory content for intelligent saving (inferring scope, categories) and consolidation (deciding insert/update/delete actions).

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: General Helper Functions
groups.description: A collection of general-purpose utility functions for string manipulation, serialization, callable resolution, and schema sanitization.

groups.label: Output & Logging
groups.title: Console Output & Agent Logs
groups.description: Provides components for formatting and printing colored console output and displaying detailed agent execution logs.

groups.label: Streaming & Async
groups.title: Asynchronous & Streaming Operations
groups.description: Manages asynchronous execution contexts and provides a base class for handling and iterating over streaming outputs from LLMs or other sources.

groups.label: Telemetry
groups.title: Anonymous Usage Tracking
groups.description: Handles anonymous telemetry collection, including usage statistics, crew execution traces, and feature usage, to help improve the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: File & Task Data
groups.title: Manage Files & Task Outputs
groups.description: Provides utilities for retrieving files associated with crew or task executions and managing the storage and retrieval of task outputs.

groups.label: Agent & Tool Interaction
groups.title: Agent-Tool Interaction Helpers
groups.description: Contains helper functions for agents, such as summarizing LLM conversations and running crew tools with specific messages.
